name: 室生寺金堂
checkpoints: FIVE-bay main hall with single hip roof; preserve its long asymmetric forward roof extension and roof dip from the photographed 1672 front modification.
Tall veranda posts over the sloping stone base, five-bay front and low railing; simple wooden doors and white infill.
No tower roof, trees, modern fencing or invented level-ground foundation.
